Editorial standards

How Workforce Observatory content is shaped.

Each article expands a LinkedIn visual carousel into a richer Workforce Observatory experience with structured metadata, scheduled publishing and build-time SEO output.

  1. Make executive implications clear before adding technical depth.
  2. Keep workforce definitions, time logic and controls visible in every argument.
  3. Prefer governed operational explanations over generic best-practice claims.
  4. Use interactive structures to reduce text walls and improve decision clarity.
